subject: Note-decay B: reinforce lane — lift confidence/structBoost for notes recalled-and-won
description:
The POSITIVE mirror of #1's retire lane (together = 're-grade by usefulness'). Forks off orch/feature/note-decay.

SCOPE: Read the recall-outcome consumer from #1. For notes recalled into APPROVED/tested tasks, apply a GRADED reinforcement to the note's retrieval weight (structBoost) and/or a confidence score — YourMemory-style recall boost but graded on OUTCOME (recalled-and-won), not mere access. Decay-on-disuse (#1) + reinforce-on-payoff (this) are the two halves. Keep boosts BOUNDED (no runaway), idempotent, and observable (log the lift per note). Tests. Commit onto orch/attempt/<key> before complete_task.
